byte_evidence: Hex bytes plus SHA256; semantic JSON equivalence does not authorize changes
unambiguous_move: Exactly one of source or destination exists with exact planned bytes
preparation_requires: Qualified OS gate held by caller
Current LOCKED recovery guard owned by caller
Original operation owner dead or PID reused
Known operation phase and child dead when applicable
No candidate adoption except already committed pointer with validated outputs
future_persistence_barriers: Write immutable plan and fsync before pinning its digest in guard
Durably link guard to plan before receipt change
Write exact planned receipt after bytes atomically
Move restore.lock if present then operation.lock without overwriting destination
Write and validate completion record before retiring current guard
future_refusals: Both or neither source and destination
Receipt unchanged before a completed move
Unattributed guard or missing plan digest
Legacy MUTATION_PENDING without matching durable transaction
completion_retry_scope: Before a later operation changes pointer/locks/receipt context
